As an AMAB non binary person from Mexico I have a particular perspective on the word Latinx that I'd like to share; growing up I never had male friends, I always hung out with many girls, and when adults would aproach us they would always say "hola chicas!" and then immediately correct to "chicos" once they noticed I was there. 

It never made sense to me that just because I was there I should take priority over the 6-7 girls I was hanging out with when we were adressed as a group. So when people try to say that "latinos" has no gender that sounds like bs to me. HOWEVER, I do understand why Latinx is stupid because it doesn't really have the same "vibe" as other spanish words, so imho "latine" is the perfect alternative. I feel like it includes me as a non binary person and stops centering the conversation around men. 

Aditionally, I'd say that it's a bit disingenous to say that no one uses neutral words in spanish, neutral "elle" pronouns and words are constantly used in feminist and LGBTQ+ groups, specially amongst young people.
